senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; שָׁחַר I, cmp. בֹּקֶר)morning dawn, early morning.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 4:1">Ber. IV, 1</cite> <he>תפלת הש׳</he> the morning prayer.
<cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 1:4">Ib. I, 4</cite> <he>בש׳ מברך וכ׳</he> when reading the Sh’mʿa in the morning prayer, you recite two benedictions &c.

<cite ref="Mishnah Tamid 4:1">Tam. IV, 1</cite> <he>של ש׳</he> (sub. <cite ref="V00672"><he>תמיד</he></cite>) the daily offering of the morning; a. v. fr.—<he>עמוד הש׳</he>, v. <cite ref="P00866"><he>עַמּוּד</he></cite>.—<he>אילת הש׳</he>, v. <cite ref="A01272"><he>אַיָּלָה</he></cite>.—Pl. <cite ref="U01527"><he>שְׁחָרִין</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="U00719"><he>שַׁחֲרִית</he></cite>.
